Package com.egradx.notification.messenger

Class EgradxMessageRequest

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.messenger.EgradxMessageRequest
public final class EgradxMessageRequest extends Object
What to send, on which channel, to whom. Built with on(EgradxChannel): 

 messenger.send(EgradxMessageRequest.on(EgradxChannel.EMAIL)
         .organization(orgId)
         .template("order.shipped", Map.of("customerName", name, "orderNumber", number))
         .toUsers(customerId)
         .attach(EgradxAttachment.of("invoice.pdf", "application/pdf", pdf))
         .build());

Either a template or ready-made content, never both. Recipients by user id, by address, or both; a person reached both ways is sent one message.

Or, instead of naming recipients, a whole audience — EgradxMessageRequest.Builder.toOrganizationMembers() or EgradxMessageRequest.Builder.toAllUsers(). That is a bulk send: checked against a cap and queued as one row at once, then expanded into deliveries in the background, a page at a time. See EgradxBulkExpander.
